summary: P0 (issue #32) completed. Phase A (repository isolation): dsh-crew now owns a dedicated DSH home (~/.config/dsh-crew/harness) and profile (dsh-crew) and a dedicated Crew Hub port (http://127.0.0.1:3210); scripts/setup.mjs runs every DSH CLI invocation with the Crew DSH_HOME in the child environment and profile dsh-crew, never the official web profile; fresh Crew config defaults to 3210 and legacy 3080 configs are read-migrated to 3210; scripts/smoke-real.mjs no longer reads ~/.dsh stores (standalone uses only explicit DEEPSEEK_API_KEY env, else BLOCKED-style exit); live-crew-smoke/live-policy-matrix target the explicit/dedicated hub; a new deterministic isolation regression test guards all these boundaries. Deterministic node --test 396/396 PASS and pnpm run build:client PASS; README (canonical) + 14 translations + docs/agent-workflow.md updated so no normal command installs/removes dsh-crew in --profile web, with official-home isolation stated. Phase B (local recovery/uninstall): stopped the residual dsh-crew MCP process; recovered the official credential store by restoring a trustworthy DSH-generated pre-change flat-format backup (loader-proven with the installed dsh-credentials-local parser; values never changed, printed, or exposed); removed @ran-sh/dsh-crew (dependency + bundle reference + node_modules) from the official web profile, leaving base/web-app bundles unchanged; uninstalled dsh-crew Codex and Claude integrations (narrowly scoped, unrelated content preserved); archived and purged ~/.config/dsh-crew state; verified no dsh-crew plugin/profile/process remains and the official DeepSeek Harness starts fresh and healthy (web root HTTP 200) without dsh-crew using the same installed binary and normal web profile. dsh-crew is left uninstalled; a reinstall requires an explicit new user request.

tests.evidence: node .agent-workflow/validator/validate-contract.mjs task docs/agent-tasks/ACTIVE_TASK.json -> VALID TASK CONTRACT (exit 0)

tests.evidence: detectDsh returns a CLI base only; runDsh always builds `plugin --profile dsh-crew` with DSH_HOME=crewDshHome(home) in the child env; profileHasPackage/setupStatus read only the dedicated Crew profile dir; install dry-run explicitly contrasts the retired 'DSH web profile would be linked' legacy phrasing with the dedicated dsh-crew profile; tests prove the official web profile fixture is ignored by uninstall/status

tests.evidence: live-crew-smoke.mjs and live-policy-matrix.mjs BASE = (DSH_CREW_HUB ?? http://127.0.0.1:3210) + /_dsh/dsh-crew; no hard-coded 3080 (added unit assertions)

tests.evidence: New test/dsh-profile-isolation.test.mjs scans the executable installer/test paths (scripts/*, src/install/install.mjs) and fails on `--profile web`, `profiles/web`, ~/.dsh credential/settings reads, readDshStore, or a default 3080 target (3080 allowed only as CREW_LEGACY_HUB_URL in install.mjs); asserts constants + legacy 3080 read-migration. Passes.

tests.evidence: README.md canonical Install/Update/Uninstall/Dev/Quick-Start rewritten to the source installer (dedicated Crew home/profile; official harness isolation note); 14 translations' unsafe `--profile web add/remove` commands replaced with a canonical-install pointer while keeping the verified GitHub-only distribution assertions satisfiable (legacy web commands retained only as an explicitly-marked unsupported reference in README.md/README.zh.md); docs/agent-workflow.md project adapter now carries a hard real-environment isolation rule
